title: In Other Words
subtitle: 換句話說；換個方式表達
description: 換句話說；換個方式表達

words.meaning: 換句話說；換個方式表達
words.note: put differently 是 in other words 最直接、最自然的近義片語之一，表示把同一個意思換一種說法重新表達，常用來澄清或簡化前一句。
words.example: The plan is too expensive; put differently, we cannot afford it.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃太昂貴；換句話說，我們負擔不起。

exercises.original: The deadline cannot be moved. In other words, we must finish the work by Friday.
exercises.zh: 截止日期不能更改。換句話說，我們必須在星期五前完成工作。
exercises.upgrade: put differently · 換句話說；換個方式表達

options.explanation: for example = 例如。後句不是例子，而是重述前句含義。
put differently = 換句話說。後句用另一種方式說明同一結論。
by contrast = 相比之下。需要兩個對比內容，這裡沒有。
in addition = 此外。表示新增資訊，不是改寫。
meanwhile = 同時。表示時間並行，不是重述。
more precisely = 更精確地說。通常是修正或縮窄前一句，這裡只是同義重述。

exercises.original: The system is no longer supported. In other words, the company will not fix future problems with it.
exercises.zh: 這個系統已不再受支援。換句話說，公司日後不會再替它修復問題。
exercises.upgrade: put differently · 換句話說；換個方式表達

options.explanation: similarly = 同樣地。表示另一件事相似，不是重述。
namely = 即；也就是列明具體名稱或項目。這裡不是列舉。
for instance = 例如。後句不是例子。
instead = 反而／代替。不是語義改寫。
put differently = 換句話說。後句解釋 no longer supported 的實際意思。
however = 然而。表示轉折，語意不合。

exercises.original: The apartment is outside our budget. In other words, we need to find somewhere cheaper.
exercises.zh: 這間公寓超出我們的預算。換句話說，我們要找更便宜的地方。
exercises.upgrade: put differently · 換句話說；換個方式表達

options.explanation: put differently = 換句話說。後句把超出預算的含義轉化成實際結論。
for example = 例如。不是舉例。
nevertheless = 儘管如此。需要轉折。
in addition = 此外。是添加新資訊。
afterward = 之後。表示時間次序。
specifically = 具體而言。通常補充細節，不是同義重述。

words.note: that is to say 是較正式、完整的說法，用來重新表述或解釋前一句。常見於書面語、演講或需要清楚澄清意思的場合。
words.example: The policy applies retrospectively; that is to say, it affects earlier cases too.
words.exampleZh: 這項政策具有追溯力；也就是說，它也影響較早的個案。

exercises.original: The payment is non-refundable. In other words, you will not get the money back if you cancel.
exercises.zh: 這筆付款不可退款。也就是說，如果取消，你不會拿回款項。
exercises.upgrade: that is to say · 也就是說；換言之

options.explanation: for instance = 例如。後句是定義性解釋，不是例子。
on the other hand = 另一方面。不是對比。
as a result = 因此。可以表示結果，但這裡核心是解釋 non-refundable 的意思。
that is to say = 也就是說。正式重述前句含義。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。
likewise = 同樣地。不是重述。

exercises.original: The test is cumulative. In other words, questions may cover material from the entire course.
exercises.zh: 這次測驗是累積性的。也就是說，題目可能涵蓋整個課程的內容。
exercises.upgrade: that is to say · 也就是說；換言之

options.explanation: similarly = 同樣地。不是重述。
therefore = 因此。較像推論結果，這句是定義 cumulative。
that is to say = 也就是說。後句直接解釋術語含義。
in contrast = 相比之下。沒有對比。
for example = 例如。不是單一例子，而是解釋。
later = 之後。無關。

exercises.original: Only authorised staff may enter. In other words, visitors must remain outside this area.
exercises.zh: 只有獲授權員工可以進入。也就是說，訪客必須留在這個區域外。
exercises.upgrade: that is to say · 也就是說；換言之

options.explanation: instead = 代替／反而。不是說明。
besides = 此外。表示新增資訊。
by contrast = 相比之下。不是比較。
for instance = 例如。後句不是例子。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。
that is to say = 也就是說。把 authorised staff only 轉述成訪客不得進入。

words.note: put another way 和 put differently 很接近，語氣自然、口語與書面都可用。常用於把抽象句子改寫成更容易理解的說法。
words.example: The market is saturated; put another way, there are already too many competitors.
words.exampleZh: 市場已飽和；換句話說，競爭者已經太多。

exercises.original: The evidence is inconclusive. In other words, we still cannot say with confidence what caused the failure.
exercises.zh: 證據沒有定論。換個方式說，我們仍不能有信心地判斷失敗原因。
exercises.upgrade: put another way · 換個方式說；換句話說

options.explanation: meanwhile = 同時。無關。
for example = 例如。不是舉例。
in contrast = 相比之下。無對比。
as well = 也。不是重述。
put another way = 換個方式說。後句把 inconclusive 改寫成較易理解的意思。
in particular = 尤其。不是改寫。

exercises.original: The company has negative cash flow. In other words, more money is leaving the business than coming in.
exercises.zh: 公司現金流為負。換句話說，流出的錢比流入的多。
exercises.upgrade: put another way · 換個方式說；換句話說

options.explanation: therefore = 因此。後句不是結果，而是 negative cash flow 的平實解釋。
put another way = 換句話說。把財務術語改成日常表達。
for instance = 例如。不是例子。
however = 然而。沒有轉折。
likewise = 同樣地。不是重述。
afterward = 之後。無關。

exercises.original: The treatment only manages the symptoms. In other words, it does not remove the underlying cause.
exercises.zh: 治療只能控制症狀。換個方式說，它不能消除根本原因。
exercises.upgrade: put another way · 換個方式說；換句話說

options.explanation: put another way = 換個方式說。後句重新表達前句。
however = 然而。雖有語意反差，但主要是在改寫 only manages symptoms 的含義。
specifically = 具體來說。可補充細節，但不是最準確的同義連接。
by contrast = 相比之下。不是兩個獨立事物比較。
for example = 例如。不是例子。
similarly = 同樣地。不是重述。

words.meaning: 換句話說；換個角度表達
words.note: to put it another way 是完整、自然的插入語，表示接下來要把同一意思重新表達。比 put another way 稍完整，也很適合演講與解釋性寫作。
words.example: To put it another way, the project costs more than it saves.
words.exampleZh: 換句話說，這個項目的成本高於節省的金額。

exercises.original: The policy shifts responsibility to local authorities. In other words, central government will no longer manage the service directly.
exercises.zh: 政策把責任轉移給地方當局。換句話說，中央政府將不再直接管理這項服務。
exercises.upgrade: to put it another way · 換句話說；換個角度表達

options.explanation: for example = 例如。不是例子。
by contrast = 相比之下。無對比。
to put it another way = 換句話說。後句將責任轉移的含義重新說明。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。
in addition = 此外。不是加入另一點。
afterward = 之後。不是時間次序。

exercises.original: The company is highly leveraged. In other words, it relies heavily on borrowed money.
exercises.zh: 公司槓桿很高。換句話說，它非常依賴借來的資金。
exercises.upgrade: to put it another way · 換句話說；換個角度表達

options.explanation: for instance = 例如。不是個別例子。
similarly = 同樣地。不是重述。
in contrast = 相比。無關。
however = 然而。無轉折。
later = 之後。無關。
to put it another way = 換句話說。把 specialised term leveraged 改寫成容易理解的說法。

exercises.original: The software is no longer backward-compatible. In other words, older files may not open correctly.
exercises.zh: 軟件已不再向後兼容。換句話說，較舊檔案可能無法正常開啟。
exercises.upgrade: to put it another way · 換句話說；換個角度表達

options.explanation: instead = 代替。不是解釋。
likewise = 同樣地。不是重述。
therefore only = 因此。後句雖可視為結果，但此處主要功能是說明 backward-compatible 的實際意思。
to put it another way = 換句話說。正確地重新說明技術詞。
in addition = 此外。不是新增獨立資訊。
for example = 例如。不是例子列表。

words.note: that is 是 that is to say 的較短形式，常用來澄清、界定或重述前面內容。書面英語中非常常見，也常縮寫為 i.e.，但正式寫作要注意標點。
words.example: The payment must be made in advance; that is, before the service begins.
words.exampleZh: 款項必須預先支付；也就是說，要在服務開始前付款。

exercises.original: The course is asynchronous. In other words, students do not have to attend live classes at a fixed time.
exercises.zh: 課程是非同步的。也就是說，學生不必在固定時間參加直播課。
exercises.upgrade: that is · 即；也就是說

options.explanation: for example = 例如。後句是在界定 asynchronous，不是例子。
that is = 即；也就是說。非常適合對術語作簡潔說明。
however = 然而。不是轉折。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。
likewise = 同樣。不是重述。
afterward = 之後。無關。

exercises.original: The rule applies retrospectively. In other words, it also covers events that happened before the rule was introduced.
exercises.zh: 這項規則具有追溯力。也就是說，它也適用於規則推出前發生的事件。
exercises.upgrade: that is · 即；也就是說

options.explanation: that is = 也就是說。直接解釋 retrospectively 的含義。
for instance = 例如。不是舉例。
therefore = 因此。不是因果。
by contrast = 相比。無對比。
specifically = 具體而言。可以補充細節，但這裡是定義性重述。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。

exercises.original: Only one vehicle is permitted per household. In other words, a family cannot register two cars for this scheme.
exercises.zh: 每戶只准一部車。也就是說，一個家庭不能為這個計劃登記兩部車。
exercises.upgrade: that is · 即；也就是說

options.explanation: similarly = 同樣地。無第二個相似情況。
in addition = 此外。不是另一項規定。
for example = 例如。不是某個可能例子，而是規則含義。
however = 然而。無轉折。
that is = 也就是說。後句直接重新界定 one vehicle per household。
later = 後來。無關。

words.meaning: 簡單來說；用更簡單的說法
words.note: 當 in other words 的目的特別是把技術、抽象或複雜內容改成更容易理解的說法時，可用 in simpler terms。它不只是重述，還明確表示『簡化』。
words.example: In simpler terms, the program learns from examples.
words.exampleZh: 簡單來說，這個程式會從例子中學習。

exercises.original: The drug inhibits viral replication. In other words, it stops the virus from making more copies of itself.
exercises.zh: 這種藥抑制病毒複製。簡單來說，它阻止病毒製造更多自身副本。
exercises.upgrade: in simpler terms · 簡單來說；用更簡單的說法

options.explanation: technically = 技術上。後句反而把技術語簡化。
in detail = 詳細地。不是增加細節，而是簡化。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。
for example = 例如。不是例子。
by contrast = 相比。無對比。
in simpler terms = 簡單來說。viral replication → making more copies 是典型技術詞簡化。

exercises.original: The device converts kinetic energy into electrical energy. In other words, movement is turned into electricity.
exercises.zh: 這個裝置把動能轉化成電能。簡單來說，移動會被轉成電力。
exercises.upgrade: in simpler terms · 簡單來說；用更簡單的說法

options.explanation: for instance = 例如。不是例子。
in contrast = 相比。不是對比。
in simpler terms = 簡單來說。把 scientific terminology 改成日常詞 movement/electricity。
therefore = 因此。不是推論結果。
afterward = 之後。無關。
likewise = 同樣地。不是重述。

exercises.original: The company is insolvent. In other words, it cannot pay what it owes.
exercises.zh: 公司已資不抵債。簡單來說，它無法償還所欠款項。
exercises.upgrade: in simpler terms · 簡單來說；用更簡單的說法

options.explanation: more precisely = 更精確地說。後句其實更簡單，而不一定更精確。
for example = 例如。不是例子。
however = 然而。無轉折。
in simpler terms = 簡單來說。insolvent 是較專門詞，後句是日常解釋。
in addition = 此外。不是新增。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。

words.note: 當 in other words 把法律、商業、科技或官僚語言改成普通人容易理解的日常英語時，可用 in plain English。語氣較直接，有時帶輕微批判『別說術語』的感覺。
words.example: In plain English, the contract says you can cancel within 14 days.
words.exampleZh: 用白話說，合約的意思是你可以在十四天內取消。

exercises.original: The clause states that the agreement may be terminated without cause. In other words, either side can end it without giving a reason.
exercises.zh: 條款說協議可無須理由終止。用白話說，任何一方都可以不交代理由便結束協議。
exercises.upgrade: in plain English · 用白話說；說白一點

options.explanation: in plain English = 用白話說。formal legal clause → everyday explanation 是典型。
for example = 例如。不是例子。
in contrast = 相比。無對比。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。
in addition = 此外。不是新增。
afterward = 之後。無關。

exercises.original: The software documentation says the process is computationally intensive. In other words, it needs a lot of processing power.
exercises.zh: 軟件文件說這個程序計算密集。用白話說，它需要大量運算能力。
exercises.upgrade: in plain English · 用白話說；說白一點

options.explanation: technically speaking = 從技術角度說。前句才是技術表達，後句是在白話化。
for instance = 例如。不是例子。
in addition = 此外。不是新增。
by contrast = 相比。無對比。
in plain English = 用白話說。technical phrase → ordinary explanation 是典型。
later = 後來。無關。

exercises.original: The notice says access is restricted to authorised personnel. In other words, ordinary visitors cannot enter.
exercises.zh: 告示說只有獲授權人員可進入。說白一點，一般訪客不能進入。
exercises.upgrade: in plain English · 用白話說；說白一點

options.explanation: therefore = 因此。後句更像規則的白話翻譯，而不是邏輯推論。
in plain English = 白話說。formal notice wording → ordinary visitors cannot enter，是典型。
for example = 例如。不是例子。
however = 然而。無轉折。
likewise = 同樣地。無第二個相似情況。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。

words.note: to rephrase 明確表示『我要把剛才的話重新說一次』。它常用於演講、討論、教學或自我修正，尤其當說話者想讓意思更清楚。
words.example: To rephrase, we need fewer features and a simpler design.
words.exampleZh: 換個說法，我們需要更少功能和更簡單的設計。

exercises.original: The project is not failing; it is simply moving more slowly than planned. In other words, we need more time, not a complete restart.
exercises.zh: 項目不是失敗，只是進度比計劃慢。換個說法，我們需要更多時間，而不是完全重來。
exercises.upgrade: to rephrase · 換個說法；重新表述

options.explanation: for example = 例如。不是例子。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。
by contrast = 相比。不是比較兩件事。
to rephrase = 換個說法。說話者主動重新表達自己的意思。
in addition = 此外。不是增加新點。
therefore only = 因此。雖有結論感，但此處主要是把前句重新表述。

exercises.original: I do not mean that the idea is bad. In other words, I think it needs more evidence before we adopt it.
exercises.zh: 我不是說這個想法不好。換個說法，我認為在採用之前還需要更多證據。
exercises.upgrade: to rephrase · 換個說法；重新表述

options.explanation: for instance = 例如。不是舉例。
however = 然而。雖可有轉折，但後句主要是澄清原意。
specifically = 具體來說。可接近，但 to rephrase 更明確表示自我重述。
similarly = 同樣地。不是重述。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。
to rephrase = 換個說法。說話者修正／澄清自己的表達。

exercises.original: The problem is not the amount of data. In other words, the real issue is how poorly it is organised.
exercises.zh: 問題不在資料量。換個說法，真正問題是資料整理得很差。
exercises.upgrade: to rephrase · 換個說法；重新表述

options.explanation: in addition = 此外。不是新增。
afterward = 之後。無關。
to rephrase = 換個說法。後句重新界定前一句真正想表達的意思。
by contrast = 相比。不是單純對比，而是重新界定問題。
therefore = 因此。不是因果推論。
for example = 例如。不是例子。

words.note: what I mean is 是很自然的口語澄清句型，用來補充、修正或重述剛才說過的話。它比 in other words 更口語、更具說話者個人色彩。
words.example: What I mean is, we need to decide before Friday.
words.exampleZh: 我的意思是，我們要在星期五前作決定。

exercises.original: I am not saying you should cancel the trip. In other words, I just think you should wait for more information.
exercises.zh: 我不是說你應該取消旅程。我的意思是，我只是覺得你應先等更多資訊。
exercises.upgrade: what I mean is · 我的意思是；換句話說

options.explanation: for example = 例如。不是例子。
in addition = 此外。不是新增觀點。
however = 然而。可有轉折，但不如口語澄清精準。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。
what I mean is = 我的意思是。直接澄清說話者先前可能被誤解的意思。
by contrast = 相比。不是對比。

exercises.original: I do not expect perfection. In other words, I only need the first version to be clear enough to review.
exercises.zh: 我不是要求完美。我的意思是，第一版只要清楚到可以審閱就行。
exercises.upgrade: what I mean is · 我的意思是；換句話說

options.explanation: what I mean is = 我的意思是。把抽象的 not expect perfection 具體澄清成最低要求。
for instance = 例如。不是舉例。
likewise = 同樣地。不是重述。
meanwhile = 同時。無關。
in contrast = 相比。不是比較。
afterward = 之後。無關。

exercises.original: The schedule is flexible. In other words, I am happy to change the meeting time if necessary.
exercises.zh: 時間表很有彈性。我的意思是，如有需要，我很樂意更改會議時間。
exercises.upgrade: what I mean is · 我的意思是；換句話說

options.explanation: for example = 例如。後句可以像例子，但說話者是在口語澄清 flexible 的意思。
what I mean is = 我的意思是。自然口語重述。
therefore = 因此。不是因果。
in addition = 此外。不是另一點。
however = 然而。無轉折。
later = 之後。無關。

falseSynonyms.zh: 例如不等於一般的 in other words for example 引出一個例子；in other words 則用不同說法重述同一意思。兩者功能不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An example illustrates a point; a rephrasing restates it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 即；也就是列明不等於一般的 in other words namely 常用來列出前面較籠統名詞的具體名稱或項目，例如 two countries, namely France and Spain。它有時和 that is 接近，但不是所有 in other words 都能換成 namely。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Namely specifies items; in other words broadly rephrases.

falseSynonyms.zh: 更精確地說不等於一般的 in other words more precisely 用來修正、縮窄或提高前一句的精確度；in other words 通常只換一種方式重述，不必更精確。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Precision is correction or refinement; rephrasing need not narrow meaning.

falseSynonyms.zh: 尤其；特別是不等於一般的 in other words in particular 從較廣內容中挑出一項重點，不是同義重述。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON In particular highlights one part; it does not restate the whole idea.

falseSynonyms.zh: 因此不等於一般的 in other words therefore 表示因果結論；in other words 表示同一意思的重新表達。某些句子兩者都能勉強成立，但邏輯功能不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Therefore draws a conclusion; in other words restates.

falseSynonyms.zh: 此外不等於一般的 in other words in addition 是加入新的資訊，而不是重新表達舊資訊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Addition adds a new point; rephrasing does not.

falseSynonyms.zh: 相比之下不等於一般的 in other words by contrast 引出差異或相反點，和 in other words 的解釋重述功能不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Contrast compares differences; rephrasing preserves meaning.

falseSynonyms.zh: 同樣地不等於一般的 in other words similarly 引出另一件相似的事，不是把同一件事換句話說。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Similarity links separate ideas; rephrasing restates one idea.
